Wait here legend (upper left): plan of an intersection approach with a curb return on each side, a stop bar across the lanes and a solid double centerline with dashed lane lines. In each of the two lanes the legend HERE is placed above WAIT. Dimensions at right: 8' from the stop bar to the HERE legend and 8' from the HERE legend to the WAIT legend.

Stop limit line, R1-1 (upper middle): plan of a corner with an access ramp, the curb line extended and the property line. The 5' min dimension is between the curb line extended and the limit line. The STOP legend is placed back from the limit line with an 8' dimension. A R1-1 STOP sign is drawn on a post beside the property line, with a larger red octagonal STOP sign labeled R1-1 below it.

Yield line, R1-2 (upper right): a row of four yield triangles (shark teeth), 36" high, each 12" wide and spaced 24" apart (12" and 24" dimensions shown), placed at the corner with the access ramp. A R1-2 YIELD sign is shown on a post, with a larger red and white YIELD sign labeled R1-2 below it.

Text under these three views: note 1 below.

Bus zone (middle left): a curb-side bus zone. A dashed lane line runs parallel to the curb, the legend BUS ZONE is set along the curb, and a bike symbol with an up arrow is placed inside the bike lane. A 6' dimension is shown for the bike lane width. A curb return closes the bottom.

Stop ahead (middle): a lane with a stop bar and curb at the top. Two lanes each carry the legend AHEAD above STOP. A dimension C is shown from the stop bar to the first (AHEAD) legend and a 32' dimension from that legend to the STOP legend.

Pedestrian crossing (middle): a marked crosswalk of vertical bars at the top, solid and dashed lane lines. Each of two lanes carries the legend XNG above PED. Dimension C is from the crosswalk to the first legend and 32' from the XNG legend to the PED legend.

A left-turn arrow is placed at the limit line end of the lane and a second arrow is placed L/2 back (dimension L/2 shown inside dimension L).
